title: SELECT, aliases and DISTINCT
theory: `SELECT` chooses columns. `AS` renames them. `DISTINCT` removes duplicate rows.

examples.title: Alias
examples.sql: SELECT name AS employee, salary * 12 AS annual FROM employees LIMIT 5;

exercises.task: List each distinct dept_id used by employees, sorted ascending.
exercises.solution: SELECT DISTINCT dept_id FROM employees ORDER BY dept_id;
